messages:
lina-cs: Hey team, just got a report from a beta customer — they saw a partial stream, then hit reconnect, and the UI showed the generator start again producing duplicated tokens. They were billed for both outputs. Can we triage?

maria-cs: Thanks Lina. Customer says sequence: start stream -> partial output (about 30%) -> network blip -> client reconnect within ~2s -> stream resumed but duplicated ~15 tokens, charged twice. Customer session_id=cs-9b7f, request_id=r-03a2.

sam-runtime: Can you paste the client reconnect snippet and any server logs around r-03a2? Need to check resume vs new-session path.

lina-cs: Repro steps they shared: 1) open SSE to /v1/chat/stream with header `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `X-Resume-Token: cs-9b7f` 2) force-close socket after ~2.5s 3) client reconnects with same resume token 4) UI shows continued stream but then an extra chunk appended. Minimal client code: ```js
const es = new EventSource(url, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ...', 'X-Resume-Token': 'cs-9b7f' } });
es.onmessage = e => { appendToUI(JSON.parse(e.data).text) }
// simulate disconnect then reconnect
es.close(); setTimeout(() => { reconnect() }, 2000);
```

josh-sre: Server-side logs around that time (trimmed): ```
[2026-02-11T15:22:01Z] r-03a2: stream_start session=cs-9b7f seq=0
[2026-02-11T15:22:03Z] r-03a2: partial_chunk seq=1 size=120
[2026-02-11T15:22:05Z] r-03a2: connection_lost clientfd=102
[2026-02-11T15:22:07Z] r-03a2: reconnect_attempt resume_token=cs-9b7f
[2026-02-11T15:22:07Z] r-03a2: resume_success last_seq=1
[2026-02-11T15:22:07Z] r-03a2: generated_chunk seq=2 size=60
[2026-02-11T15:22:07Z] r-03a2: generated_chunk seq=2 size=60 (duplicate?)
```

sam-runtime: Interesting — log shows two generated_chunk entries with same seq=2. That implies the resume path replayed a generation request while another generation worker also completed simultaneously. Might be a race where resume triggers a new forward pass while a previously buffered forward finishes and both are emitted.

maria-cs: Customer asked if this is billable? They were charged for the extra 60 tokens. They want credits for duplicates and a mitigation plan.

zoe-billing: Please open a billing ticket referencing r-03a2 and cs-9b7f; we can offer a one-time credit pending engineering confirmation. I can start the credit hold once eng confirms duplication.

sam-runtime: Root cause hypothesis: for short disconnects (<3s) our resume handshake sometimes doesn't acquire an in-flight generation lock. Flow: client reconnects -> orchestrator sees resume token -> starts a resume replay request -> if previous generation finishes exactly as resume issues, both results are emitted. Fixes: (a) make resume handshake wait for worker-idempotency-token verification before issuing a replay; (b) add server-side duplicate suppression by deduping identical (request_id, seq) outputs within a short window; (c) client-side heuristic: on reconnect, delay UI append of first incoming chunk until we confirm resume state from server via explicit 'resume_ack' event.

lina-cs: Can we patch a short-term mitigation for the customer (config toggle)? They need low-friction option.

sam-runtime: We can enable server-side 'suppress-duplicate-output' flag for that org for the next 48h. It will drop exact-match repeats within 5s of original emission. Will need rollout from runtime team, low risk.

josh-sre: Also want to log a correlation id when resume is requested so we can count dup events at scale. Add `X-Resume-Correlation` in logs and SSE events.

zoe-billing: I'll queue the provisional credit once eng confirms. For customer comms: offer apology + explanation + temporary credit + ETA for permanent fix.

maria-cs: Customer is ok with a temporary credit if we flip the flag. Can you confirm ETA?

sam-runtime: I can flip the flag for that org in ~2 hours (permissions check) and instrument logs in the same deploy. Permanent fix estimate: 2 weeks for lock-based handshake + testing.

lina-cs: Thanks. I'll send the customer a note: "We're enabling a temporary duplicate suppression flag and issuing a provisional credit; engineering is tracking a bug and we expect a permanent fix in ~2 weeks."

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime/duplicate-suppress-flag enabled for org cs-9b7f by sam-runtime at 2026-02-11T17:30:00Z (rollback window 30m).

josh-sre: Follow-ups: 1) add unit test for resume race, 2) create small load test to validate no perf regression, 3) postmortem draft in #postmortems once fix lands.

maria-cs: I'll update the ticket with the plan and credit note. Lina, please paste the final customer-facing wording when ready.

lina-cs: Will do. Thanks all — I'll close the loop after deploy and billing note."
